description:
Adds map generators that put geological features from more than one climate on the same map.

Each generator is a stock one with extra features confined to regions of the map, so one side can look different from the other. The first is Temperate + Mesas: the temperate generator with the desert's mesas rising from the plains in part of the map. Pick it from the Generator list in the new game dialog; the stock sliders still work.

Ground textures and vegetation stay those of the chosen climate.

AI Disclaimer: Claude Code was used to create this mod.
name: Mapzilla
summary: Map generators that mix geological features from different climates.
